text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I'm totally exhausted~. Hey, 
hey, care to pamper me a bit?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just kidding. Looks like I have an 
interview after this, so I need to put in 
one last burst of effort!
choice_data_list: The Satsuki Sho is finally up next.
The Satsuki Sho is finally up next!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's a grand stage, so it's guaranteed to 
be exciting! Let's do our best and aim for 
the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off to do the interview.

And so, the Spring Stakes—a crucial prep 
race for the Classics—came to an end.
That night—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Maruzen-san's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Working this late? Um, thank you for your 
hard work!
choice_data_list:
Are you doing extra training on your own 
this late?

Are you doing extra training this late at 
night?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, oh no!? I'm supposed to be 
training in secret!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah~ please let me off the hook! If they 
find out I was running this late, I'm 
gonna get yelled at~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Running is really fun for me 
right now. Even if it's little by little, 
I can feel myself growing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Times when I feel like I've gotten just a 
little closer to Maruzen-san, whom I 
admire so much.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Satsuki Sho, right?! I bet 
we're gonna see an incredible race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Both Grass-chan and I are really looking 
forward to seeing you run, Maruzen-san, so 
do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! Well then, Trainer, good night~!

A junior desperately chasing after her 
senior—

In contrast to Maruzensky right now, the 
back of the person running off looked full 
of joy.
